# Motion (29)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **animated-beam** (AnimatedBeam): An SVG beam that connects two elements with a curved path and sends a glowing gradient pulse along it. Not for: Real, data-driven graphs with many nodes (use a graph library).
- **animated-grid** (AnimatedGrid): A decorative hairline grid background where a few random cells softly light up and fade, like instrument lights. Not for: Behind dense text or data (it competes with content).
- **animated-list** (AnimatedList, AnimatedListItem): A live feed where new items spring in at the top and the rest glide down, with leave animations, an item cap, an optional fading tail and a polite announcement for new… Not for: Static lists (stagger-list).
- **animated-number-flow** (AnimatedNumberFlow): A number whose digits roll like an odometer to the new value, with locale and Intl formatting for currency, percent and compact notation, and widths that animate as… Not for: A one-time count-up on scroll (number-ticker).
- **blur-fade** (BlurFade, BlurFadeGroup): A wrapper that fades content in while it unblurs and slides a few pixels, once it scrolls into view, with a group that staggers its children. Not for: Text that should animate letter by letter (text-animate).
- **border-beam** (BorderBeam): A short beam of light that travels around the inside edge of its parent's border at a constant speed. Not for: Several elements on the same screen; one beam per view.
- **confetti** (ConfettiButton, fireConfetti, useConfetti): Confetti in your theme colors: fireConfetti(), a useConfetti() hook that fires from an element, and a ConfettiButton. Not for: Routine actions such as saving a form (use a toast or inline check).
- **glare-hover** (GlareHover): Wraps any content so a diagonal band of light sweeps across it on hover or keyboard focus, in white for images and dark surfaces or a soft shadow for light ones. Not for: Pointer-following lighting (magic-card or spotlight-card).
- **glow-border** (GlowBorder): Wraps any content in a border drawn by a rotating conic gradient in theme colors, with a soft outer glow. Not for: Several elements at once on the same screen (use it for one focal point).
- **icon-cloud** (IconCloud): Icons, logos or labels orbiting on a 3D sphere, spun by dragging, calming under the pointer and when anything has focus, with real list markup so every item stays… Not for: Anything people must read quickly.
- **in-view** (InView): A wrapper that knows when it is on screen: it sets a data attribute for CSS, offers a render function and callbacks, and can run a simple entrance. Not for: Staggered groups (blur-fade or stagger-list).
- **lens** (Lens): A magnifying lens that follows the pointer over an image or any content, moves with the arrow keys when focused, hides on Escape and keeps the copy inside it out of the… Not for: Full-screen image viewing (use a dialog).
- **magic-card** (MagicCard): A card with a two-color light that follows the pointer along its border, with an optional soft glow inside, driven by CSS variables so moving never re-renders, and a… Not for: Dense data UI.
- **magnetic-button** (MagneticButton): The Ballmac Button with a magnetic pull: it drifts toward a nearby mouse pointer on a spring, and its label moves a little further for depth. Not for: Forms, toolbars and dense UI (use button).
- **marquee** (Marquee): An endless horizontal or vertical scroller for logo rows and testimonials. Not for: Content people must read or act on in full (use a grid or carousel with controls).
- **neon-card** (NeonCard): A card framed by a two-color neon border with a soft outer light and inner glow, tunable thickness, intensity and corner radius, with an optional warm-up flicker that… Not for: Several cards at once.
- **number-ticker** (NumberTicker): Counts up to a number when it scrolls into view, with locale-aware formatting for currency, percentages and decimals. Not for: Numbers that update every second (animate a live value instead).
- **orbiting-circles** (OrbitingCircles): Items that orbit a center on circular tracks while staying upright. Not for: Items people must read or click reliably (moving targets); use a grid.
- **progressive-blur** (ProgressiveBlur): A blur that ramps up toward an edge instead of switching on at a line, made of stacked backdrop-filter layers, for scrolling lists, headers, footers and image captions. Not for: Browsers or surfaces without backdrop-filter support (it degrades to no blur).
- **pulse-button** (PulseButton): A call-to-action button that sends soft rings outward to ask for attention, calming as soon as it is hovered or focused, and switchable off once the person acts. Not for: More than one per view.
- **rainbow-button** (RainbowButton): A button with a border of theme colors circling it and a glow on hover, built on the Ballmac button so every size, variant and focus state still works. Not for: Several buttons on one screen.
- **scroll-velocity** (ScrollVelocity): A looping row of text or logos that drifts sideways and speeds up, or reverses, with how fast you scroll the page or any scroll container, repeating itself to fill the… Not for: A steady marquee that ignores scroll (marquee).
- **shimmer-text** (ShimmerText): Text with a band of light sweeping across it, from muted to full foreground color. Not for: Paragraphs or long text (the sweep becomes distracting).
- **shiny-button** (ShinyButton): A button with a diagonal band of light that sweeps across on hover and focus, or on a timer to draw the eye, built on the Ballmac button. Not for: Dense toolbars.
- **smooth-cursor** (SmoothCursor): A custom cursor for one area that glides after the pointer on a spring, leans into the direction of travel, shrinks on press and grows a label over elements marked with… Not for: Form-heavy or data-dense screens.
- **spotlight-card** (SpotlightCard): A card whose surface and border pick up a soft glow that follows the pointer, driven by CSS variables with no re-render per move. Not for: Dense data tables or long lists of cards (the effect loses meaning when everything glows).
- **stagger-list** (StaggerList, StaggerItem): A list or grid whose items arrive one after another from any direction, then glide to their new places when filtered, sorted, added or removed. Not for: A live feed where new items push others down (animated-list).
- **text-reveal** (TextReveal): Reveals a headline or paragraph word by word or character by character with a soft blur and rise, when it scrolls into view or on mount. Not for: Body copy, UI labels or anything users need to read immediately.
- **tilt-card** (TiltCard, TiltCardLayer): A card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with spring smoothing and a moving glare. Not for: Dense grids of many cards (the motion competes; use spotlight-card).
